title: Several request values with no set operator
question: How does an operator without ForAllValues or ForAnyValue treat a key with several values? AWS says such keys need a set operator, but not what happens without one. The analyzer refuses.

cases.name: string_equals
cases.description: StringEquals aws:TagKeys campus, for a request that adds the tags campus and grade.

cases.name: string_not_equals
cases.description: StringNotEquals aws:TagKeys campus, for the same request.

readings.ALLOW: it acts like ForAnyValue: grade differs
readings.IMPLICIT_DENY: it acts like ForAllValues: campus matches
